svg.title: Taba: open-source messaging that replaces SQS, SNS, Kafka and RabbitMQ with a single Docker image
svg.desc: A 3-node cluster, every node running the same image, drawn as 3-story buildings. Several producers come and go and publish messages; each message has a primary node, which replicates it to the other two, and every node is the primary of some of them. Consumers arrive later, read asynchronously and confirm with an ack, and the message leaves all 3 nodes.
